newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks firm slightly in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks firm slightly in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks firmed slightly in early morning trade on Wednesday.
Brokers said the investment environment was supportive to the stock market, but that the Nikkei average was likely to have only a limited scope to rise after its recent gains.
The key Nikkei 225 average was up 22.46 points or 0.10 percent at 21,485.43 at 0011 GMT. Its December futures were up 20 points at 21,520.
"The outer environment is favorable, but due to the unclear political outlook, there might not be rising momentum," said Yoshihiro Ito, general manager at Okasan Securities Co Ltd.
